task: Add four Android system integrations to the Expo mobile app: biometric app lock + launcher shortcuts, home-screen widget, recording notification action buttons, auto-pause on phone calls
acceptanceCriteria: app lock covers the (app) group without unmounting it or stopping a recording
app lock re-locks after 30s in background and needs auth to enable or disable
three launcher shortcuts route to recording setup, ask and actions through the (app) guard
widget renders signed-out, normal, recording and empty states from a stored snapshot
widget hides the meeting title when the app lock is on
notification buttons call session pause/resume/end and follow the phase
call interruption auto-resumes only a pause the call caused
existing mobile and api suites stay green and the Android build compiles
blastRadius: recording session pause/resume/end and the foreground service
app boot and the (app) route guard
contracts: deep links meetio://recording-setup, meetio://meeting-detail?id=, meetio://actions, meetio://recording-live
